product.name: Veery
product.description: A satellite weather radar that monitors global ocean winds, soil moisture, and sea ice using 5 GHz radio waves, designed to be cost-effective and rapidly deployable.

product.description: Monitors real-time hurricane winds at the surface from formation through rapid intensification and landfall.

product.name: Surface Soil Moisture
product.description: Provides data on soil moisture levels, which is crucial for understanding drought conditions and agricultural planning.

product.name: Sea Ice Coverage
product.description: Tracks the extent and changes in sea ice, important for climate monitoring and navigation.
